liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Digital Black &gt**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **Han-Tyumi, The Confused Cyborg &gt**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **Soy-Protein Munt Machine &gt**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **Vomit Coffin &gt**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **Sad Pilot &gt**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [5]
- **Rats in the Sky &gt**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [5]
- **Daily Blues -&gt**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [5]
- **Interior People &gt**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]

## The recordings

- **kglw2024-11-08.SP-CMC-2** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 142 min [1]
- **kglw2024-11-08**: source not stated; 20 songs; 143 min [2]
- **kglw2024-11-08.THOR**: source not stated; 3 songs; 142 min [3]
- **kglw2024-11-08.bandcampbootlegger**: soundboard; 0 songs; 143 min [4]

## Around the show

- The band dedicated the song to Elvis Presley [1]
- Slot machine vocal samples and Magenta Mountain teases appeared [1]
- Elvis Presley received a dedication during this performance [2]
- Slot machine samples and 'cashing the check' chants were heard [2]
- Sam Joseph, Joe Santarpia, Grace Reader, and Gaspard De Meulemeester recorded [4]
- PH Live staff hosted the band for the Las Vegas show [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2024-11-08.SP-CMC-2**: taped by Goomblsnax_II; transferred by Goomblsnax_II; source: SP-CMC-2 > SP-SPSB-10 > Roland R-07 (24/96 WAV) > microSD [1]. Also: Roland R-07 recorded 24/96 WAV from mics near the sound booth [1]
- **kglw2024-11-08**: taped by discocape; transferred by discocape; source: Schoeps cmc1k/mk21 [2]. Also: Schoeps mics recorded 32-bit float audio, transferred by discocape [2]
- **kglw2024-11-08.THOR**: taped by puffanug; transferred by puffanug; source: ADK Thor>PMD 661>24/96 wav [3]. Also: ADK T7 THORs recorded 32-bit float audio near the front of house [3]
- **kglw2024-11-08.bandcampbootlegger**: taped by Sam Joseph, Joe Santarpia, Grace Reader, Gaspard De Meulemeester; source: SBD [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by KGLW.net: [King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard setlist - 2024-11-08 PH Live, Las Vegas, NV, USA](https://kglw.net/setlists/king-gizzard-the-lizard-wizard-november-8-2024-ph-live-las-vegas-nv-usa.html) [6]
